hikeWater.title: Which water does the hike keep?
hikeWater.lede: Three versions of the water on Alfredo’s hike map, at the Halfway step. The stream comes over the mountains, the waterfall is back in its rock, and a side stream joins the main one below the bridge. The map, trail and story are the same in each; only the water’s look changes.
hikeWater.a.name: A · Flat
hikeWater.a.about: Canvas 2D, no Three.js. Flat layered water, a darker bank and a lighter body, with light dashes drifting downstream, streaks falling down the sheet and rings on the pool and the lake.
hikeWater.b.name: B · Three.js, flat
hikeWater.b.about: Retired after the first review; C carries this layer forward. A Three.js layer draws only the water, still in flat colours: soft bands moving along the streams, a falling sheet with foam where it lands, gentle rings on the pool and the lake.
hikeWater.c.name: C · Three.js with light
hikeWater.c.about: B plus light on the water: small moving glints on the streams and the lake, a soft shimmer on the fall, and streams a touch darker in the middle than at their edges.
hikeWater.fallback: This browser has no WebGL, so the map shows version A’s still drawing.
